item.title: Literary Prizewinners Are Facing AI Allegations. It Feels Like the New Normal
item.description: Three of five regional winners of the prestigious Commonwealth Short Story Prize are suspected of relying on chatbots. They’re certainly not alone.

item.title: Everything Announced at Google I/O 2026: Gemini, Search, Smart Glasses
item.description: Google is sprucing up its Gemini models, revamping search, and enabling AI agents in everything. There are also some spiffy new smart glasses coming this fall.

item.title: Meta Employees Are Scrambling to Use Up Benefits Ahead of Layoffs
item.description: On the eve of about 8,000 jobs being cut, employees are cashing in on headphone stipends and other perks while they still can.

item.title: Demis Hassabis Thinks AI Job Cuts Are Dumb
item.description: The CEO of Google DeepMind tells WIRED that companies should use the productivity gains of AI to do more, not lay people off.

item.title: Google Makes It Easy to Deepfake Yourself
item.description: Google’s overhaul of its AI creation software, Flow, includes a new video model and a tool for generating selfie videos called avatars.

item.title: Google Search Goes Agentic—and Doesn’t Need You Anymore
item.description: Vibe-coded results! Super widgets! Bots that never sleep! Google’s vision for the future of Search is hyper-personalized, automated, and extremely AI.

item.title: Gemini Spark Is Google’s Response to OpenClaw’s 24/7 AI Agent
item.description: Google’s always-running, data-hungry AI agent is designed to spend your money and send your emails.

item.title: Former OpenAI Staffers Warn That xAI’s Poor Safety Record Could Complicate SpaceX’s IPO
item.description: The ex-employees, who cofounded a new AI watchdog group, say investors deserve more information about xAI’s safety practices before SpaceX goes public.

item.title: Tom Steyer Wants to Save California From Billionaires. But Also Doesn’t Want Them to Leave
item.description: The hedge fund billionaire turned gubernatorial candidate wants to tax California’s ultrawealthy, regulate AI, and keep Silicon Valley happy at the same time. Good luck with that.

item.title: Elon Musk Loses Landmark Lawsuit Against OpenAI
item.description: The nine-member panel took only two hours to return a verdict in favor of OpenAI on Monday, which the judge quickly adopted as her own final decision.
